description: Displayed on the base; former registration F-THCF. Mirage IV disposal list compiled by 'BEN' on the Delta Reflex forum (December 2023), which tracks all 62 Mirage IVA/IVP airframes individually.
Recorded as displayed on Base Aerienne 110 Creil; carried the codes 3-II, 4-AA and 4-AL in service. Listed in the fr.wikipedia Dassault Mirage III survivor list.
